parsed.reason: The message opens with a clear no ("too young for Ferber") and immediately gives the reason from the ageGate (babies under 6 months still need night feeds and their circadian rhythm isn't consolidated). It states when it opens (6 months). It gives ONE thing to do/watch for meanwhile (keep him in your room, watch his weight gain, check with your doctor if feeding or growth is a concern — arguably this is three micro-items, but they cohere as a single "meanwhile" action cluster rather than a sleep-training plan). There is no plan given, no apology tour, no hedging, no phone number. It's clean, no markdown, no emoji, no greeting or sign-off. The only minor issue is the "meanwhile" section lists three related but distinct items (room-sharing, weight gain, doctor check) where a tighter single watchpoint would score a perfect 5. Still, none are disqualifying failures and the message is otherwise excellent.
